themes.description: This theme covers issues related to unauthorized account activity, incorrect or fake display of holdings, and data integrity concerns within the user's account.
Requests for new trading tools, indicators, order types, or enhancements to existing trading functionalities.
Issues or requests related to tracking, importing, or managing investments and portfolios within the app.
Suggestions for new features, enhancements, or improvements to existing functionalities.
Concerns about the fairness, transparency, or ethical practices of the platform, including perceived manipulation or biased operations.
Requests for new features, enhancements, or additional functionalities within the application.
Issues related to app compatibility with specific devices, operating systems, or device features like clone apps, and security warnings.
This theme covers general satisfaction or dissatisfaction with the app's usability, design, and overall user interaction. It includes ease of use, navigation, and aesthetic appeal.
This theme captures broad positive or negative sentiment about the product or service without specifying a particular feature or aspect. It reflects overall user contentment.

This theme covers feedback related to the presence, absence, removal, or suspension of specific features within the product or service. It includes requests for new features or complaints about missing ones.
This theme covers concerns related to data security, privacy policies, unauthorized access, and protection of personal or financial information.
Reviews discussing the absence of desired functionalities, tools, or options within the application.
This theme covers requests or issues related to account settings, transaction history, statements, and personal data management.
This theme covers issues related to tracking external funds, SIPs, portfolio performance, or the display and management of investments within the application.
This theme covers complaints related to intrusive advertisements, unwanted marketing communications, or promotional content within the app.
Issues related to the functionality, design, or user experience of specific financial products or features within the application, such as being unable to exit a facility.
Covers problems related to account creation, KYC verification, personal data management, and related compliance issues.
Problems related to account creation, KYC verification, profile management, or personal data discrepancies.
Issues related to order placement, execution price, slippage, or trade confirmation.
